'''SlaynRoche Co.''' was the manufacturer of the [[Verpine asteroid director]]. The company was subsidiary to [[Slayn & Korpil/Legends|Slayn & Korpil]], owned and operated by the [[Verpine/Legends|Verpine]] of the [[Roche asteroid field]].
